output_format: reader-raw JSON: {reader_id, per_image:[{image, flags:[{flag_id, category, confidence, abstain, frame_box_pct, location_evidence}]}], reading_notes}; five-key projection flag_id/category/confidence/abstain/frame_box_pct plus location_evidence free text; frame_box_pct is the box in fractions of the full image frame [x0,y0,x1,y1]
